pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: No GPS in this tunnel. Why is the dot still moving?
Your map is guessing, on purpose.
It keeps your last speed and heading. That's dead reckoning.
Sensors can catch curves, and map matching keeps it on the road.
But guesses drift. In our simulation, the dot ran ninety meters ahead.
Some tunnels add [Waze](/wˈAz/) beacons, so phones still get location.
Building a map? Grow the blue circle while guessing, then snap back to GPS.
